IOVA.summary: The IOVA community is buzzing with excitement following the earnings call and transcript, which revealed that the company can now identify highly responsive patient populations across solid tumors covering more than 90% of all cancers. This is seen as a major breakthrough that could expand the market for their lead therapy, Amtagvi (lifileucel). Investors are also optimistic about upcoming catalysts: a September guidance revision, Q4 lung cancer data, Q3 earnings growth, potential UK approval by year-end, and an early 2027 submission for lung cancer. The revenue projections are ambitious: $1B from secondary melanoma alone in a few years, $2B from frontline melanoma, and even larger from NSCLC. Some are comparing IOVA to REPL (Replimune) but many are tired of the comparison, believing IOVA's unique approach will prevail. There is also discussion about the label for RP1 (a competitor product) showing lower response rates and durability, which could favor Amtagvi. Overall sentiment is strongly bullish, with 28 bullish tags vs 2 bearish on Stocktwits, and Reddit mentions spiked from 0 to 13 in 24 hours, ranking 49th. Investors are reminded that IOVA is not just Amtagvi; the bigger opportunity lies in upcoming trials, especially in lung cancer. However, some caution that oncologists might prefer Amtagvi if patients are eligible, given real-world data. The community is confident and looking forward to a series of positive events.
